remarks: Handsome, sunny 5BR/3.2B Colonial bursting w/brilliant space, design, style, character & versatility! It's beautifully set on a true park-like acre in prized Upper Newfield fine homes neighb'hd boasting City water & sewers! At back, enjoy sprawling tiered deck viewing glorious level grounds bordering golf course greens; at front, a graceful veranda embraces the home. Charming interior boasts fine millwork, rich hardwoods, 2-fireplaces, French doors, lg suite comprised of a spectacular Great rm, w/soaring ceiling, library wall+loft & Palladian window, plus 2nd main flr powder rm. Great rm complements the Family rm w/fpl + office alcove just off the EIK, or provides versatile space for prof'l office, in-laws or nanny w/pvt entry off the veranda. Grand-size, elegant LR & DR are perfect for entertaining, while generous-size EIK is ideal for gourmet chef w/Thermador prof'l range, a Sub-Zero full-size refrigerator & a Sub-Zero freezer, lg island, abundant cabinetry & granite countertops! Lg breakfast rm area has French door access to stunning deck & prop. Upstairs there's flex space den/sitting/play rm+5BRs & 3Bs that incl Primary suite w/rm-size outfitted WI closet & luxe bath. Roomy, sunny BRs all have hardwoods. Walkout LL has mudrm entry, lg playrm, add'l rm+storage & mechanicals. Amenities incl C/A, security, Nest Thermostat, 3c garage, sprinkler system-Feature sheet tells all! Prized location-mins to schools, tennis, golf, restaurants, shops & Pkwy. Superb opportunity!
